title: Evaluate Kimi K2.7 Code against GLM 5.3 as a cloud ladder rung
description: Cloudflare's Pi harness announcement (2026-10-02, https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-10-02-pi-harness/) uses @cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code on Workers AI — a coding model inside the Workers-AI-only cloud rule. Compare it with GLM 5.3 (strong) and GLM 5.3 Flash (economy) on real ticfac ticks: replay a sample of closed ticks' implement attempts (same base, same prompt) through pi in the cloud worker image, measure pass-rate at the gate, cost, wall time, report linter pushbacks. Decide the ladder (.tick/runners.cloud.toml [tier_policy]) from the evidence.
acceptance_criteria: [1] A committed comparison report over >=10 replayed ticks per model. [2] runners.cloud.toml updated (or explicitly left) with the reason recorded. [3] No claude anywhere in the cloud path.
